sn20.7:1.2: bhūtapubbaṃ bhikkhave, dasārahānaṃ āṇako nāma mudiṅgo ahosi.
sn20.7:1.3: tassa dasārahā āṇake phaḷite aññaṃ āṇiṃ odahiṃsu.
sn20.7:1.4: ahu kho so bhikkhave samayo yaṃ āṇakassa mudiṅgassa porāṇaṃ pokkhara phalakaṃ antaradhāyi,
sn20.7:1.6: evameva kho bhikkhave, bhavissanti bhikkhū anāgatamaddhānaṃ, ye te suttantā tathāgatabhāsitā gambhīrā gambhīratthā lokuttarā suññatapaṭisaṃyuttā, tesu bhaññamānesu na sussūsissanti, na sotaṃ odahissanti, na aññācittaṃ upaṭṭhāpessanti. na ca te dhamme uggahetabbaṃ pariyāpuṇitabbaṃ maññissanti.
sn20.7:2.1: ye pana te suttantā kavikatā kāveyyā cittakkharā cittabyañjanā bāhirakā sāvakabhāsitā, tesu bhaññamānesu sussūsissanti, sotaṃ odahissanti, aññācittaṃ upaṭṭhāpessanti te ca dhamme uggahetabbaṃ pariyāpuṇitabbaṃ maññissanti.
sn20.7:2.2: evametesaṃ bhikkhave, suttantānaṃ tathāgatabhāsitānaṃ gambhīrānaṃ gambhīratthānaṃ lokuttarānaṃ suññatapaṭisaṃyuttānaṃ antaradhānaṃ bhavissati.
sn20.7:2.4: “ye te suttantā tathāgatabhāsitā gambhīrā gambhīratthā lokuttarā suññatapaṭisaṃyuttā, tesu bhaññamānesu sussūsissāma, sotaṃ odahissāma, aññācittaṃ upaṭṭhāpessāma. te ca dhamme uggahetabbaṃ pariyāpuṇitabbaṃ maññissāmāti.
